svg.title: Winding Stair — Spiral lantern stair
svg.desc: The tower’s cutaway exposes alternating landings rather than a single diagonal. Rest alcoves and a central rope connect both sides of the stair. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: The tower’s cutaway exposes alternating landings rather than a single diagonal. Rest
alcoves and a central rope connect both sides of the stair.
7 raised landings · 2 stairs · 3 ropes · 2 ladders · 24 props
